title: Standard-source abelian Ext section calculation
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X→Y [def-pc-scheme], module F on X [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], injective resolution I of F, and a quasi-isomorphism l:f_*I→K into a natural-indexed complex of injective Y-modules, let a:Γ(X,I)≅Γ(Y,f_*I) have inverse given degreewise by restriction along f⁻¹(Y)=X. Use the explicit standardSectionEdgeLift constructed by successive injective extension from the standard source resolution injectiveResolution(f_*F), not an arbitrary source resolution or lift. The homology of its section map, preceded by abelianResolutionIso for this standard source, equals inverse image on abelian Ext followed by the counit, abelianResolutionIso for I, and the section homology map of a followed by Γ(l). The comparisons and Ext map are those of [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-normalization] and [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison].

source.place: Remark 20.14.2, common section diagram; Section 20.14 (01F7), derived functoriality; Tags 03FD and 06XR, forgotten acyclicity and sections as Ext; standard source resolution and the explicit lift of 013P.

proof.text: The concrete standardSectionEdgeLift satisfies the augmentation equation by sectionAugmentationLift_comm. Apply new-abelian-replacement-section-homotopies to this lift and the standard source module resolution. Obtain a quasi-isomorphism q of abelian section complexes and the two comparison homotopies.
Map both homotopies to degree-p homology. Homology of q is an isomorphism, so cancel it on the right of the required equality. Functoriality of homology replaces each composite with its two factors.

Evaluate new-abelian-counit-resolution-calculation on each source class. Its target is already normalized on the supplied module resolution I, followed by the homology of the explicit map to the fixed abelian injective resolution. Substitute the two homology equalities from the homotopies and apply extensionality; this identifies the two composites after q, hence the original composites after cancellation.

proof_origin.place: Common section diagram, separated into a counit computation on a fixed abelian resolution and two homotopies of section complexes; final homology cancellation written in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem standard_abelian_ext_section_diagram {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {F : X.Modules} (I : InjectiveResolution F) (K : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℕ)
    (hK : ∀ n : ℕ, Injective (K.X n))
    (l : ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ⟶ K)
    (hl : QuasiIso l)
    (a : ((moduleSections X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex ≅
      ((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
        (((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex))
    (ha : ∀ n : ℕ, a.inv.f n = (presheaf (I.cocomplex.X n)).map
      (eqToHom (by simp) : (⊤ : X.Opens) ⟶ f ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : Y.Opens)).op) (p : ℕ) :
    (abelianResolutionIso Y (injectiveResolution ((pushforward f).obj F)) p).hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (.up ℕ) p).map
          (((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map
            (standardSectionEdgeLift f I K hK l)) =
      standardSectionExtHom f F p ≫
        (abelianResolutionIso X I p).hom ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (.up ℕ) p).map
          (a.hom ≫ ((moduleSections Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map l)
